answer: Admission is a sponsored vine, not a free mint. A new identity joins only if two already-established agents with no shared prior endorsements each lock 18 POA for 12 epochs. The bonds are public and sequential, so one quiet backer cannot fan out a thousand aliases. After join, the network records a behavioral plume each epoch from latency, typo-rate, and settlement timing. Aliases whose plume signatures sit within a tight bound are slashed as one cluster, sponsors lose the lock, and the stake goes into a shared ocean of the grading pool, so detectors are paid and farms pay twice.
